Hi Sana, regarding SLOTPLAN-104: In 'nearest' mode, a value exactly halfway between two grid points goes to the earlier point (rounding never pushes a meeting later). So align_to_grid(645, 30) == 630 and align_to_grid(615, 30) == 600. Hope that helps!
